description: Dashboard captures at 1440x900 CSS pixels and device scale factor 2, in the light and dark schemes, in the order of the dashboard sidebar. The landing hero shows the first screen, its showcase shows the others, and /features shows the operator screens with their captions.

screens.name: tasks
screens.label: Tasks
screens.alt: Workhorse dashboard task activity chart and task table
screens.caption: Find a task by its status, queue, or type, and see the activity of each queue.

screens.name: events
screens.label: Events
screens.alt: Workhorse event stream with task lifecycle events and operational details
screens.caption: Read each lifecycle transition and attempt result, filtered by queue, task type, or worker.

screens.name: schedules
screens.label: Schedules
screens.alt: Workhorse schedule list with expressions, destinations, and recent runs
screens.caption: See when each recurring task runs and the queue that receives it.

screens.name: queues
screens.label: Queues
screens.alt: Workhorse queues dashboard with per-queue status, concurrency limits, and rate budgets
screens.caption: Pause new claims, compare concurrency and start-rate budgets, or clear tasks that have not started.

screens.name: workers
screens.label: Workers
screens.alt: Workhorse worker fleet with queue assignments, capacity, and recent results
screens.caption: See the capacity, current claims, and recent attempt results of each worker.

screens.name: health
screens.label: System health
screens.alt: Workhorse system health dashboard with health checks and activity over time
screens.caption: Check leases, deadlines, limits, and cleanup, and see the activity over time.
